description: Start a Site Health audit of one property. mode full (the default) crawls the property, then audits every page the crawl leaves; a crawl already running is joined and audits when it ends. mode sample audits a few pages from every section plus the priority pages; page_ids (1 to 100) re-audits only those pages, which is how a fix is checked. Refused with 400 when the property is disabled. mode full is refused with 409 when a full audit already covers the property or a sample or page_ids audit holds it (try again once that ends). mode sample and page_ids are refused with 409 while any crawl or audit of the property runs, with 400 when the property has no pages yet, and with 404 when a page id is not in the current inventory. Returns the run id (null while a crawl runs first, since its audit run is created when the crawl ends), the property name, how many pages the run reads (in mode full, the inventory before the crawl), whether it is a sample and whether a crawl runs first. Results reach the issue list as the run progresses; the properties list shows the run's status. Requires Site Health on the website's plan; otherwise the call fails with 403.

mode.description: full crawls the property first and audits every page it leaves; sample audits a few pages per section plus the priority pages.

page_ids.description: Re-audit only these pages (1 to 100), from the inventory or an issue's affected pages. Overrides mode.

property_id.description: The property to audit, from the properties list.

name: start_site_health_audit
